title: Belgian Liege Pearl-Sugar Waffles
hookLine: Rich brioche waffle dough studded with Belgian pearl sugar that caramelizes into crunchy pockets.

items.name: Bread flour + instant yeast + 2 tbsp milk
Belgian pearl sugar (or crushed sugar cubes)

steps.title: Heat Oil & Prep Cooling Rack
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour neutral frying oil into a heavy pot to 2 inches deep and heat steadily to 350°F (175°C). Set a wire cooling rack over paper towels nearby and measure out {flour_bw} and {butter_bw} so everything is ready to fry cleanly.

steps.title: Mix Rich Dough & Fold Pearl Sugar
steps.instructionTemplate: Knead {flour_bw} and {butter_bw} 5 mins, rest 30 mins, then gently knead in {pearl_bw} right before pressing. Keep {flour_bw} and {butter_bw} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Press 4 Mins Until Caramelized
steps.instructionTemplate: Press portions in a hot waffle iron 4 minutes until deep amber caramelized pockets coat the outside. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {pearl_bw}. Serve Belgian Liege Pearl-Sugar Waffles fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 25 mins.
